// note: Example .claude/settings.local.json autoMode block. JSONC: comments allowed for documentation; the live serializer canonicalizes to strict JSON. Demonstrates the four official autoMode sections (environment / allow / soft_deny / hard_deny) using prose rules, with `$defaults` per section. Also demonstrates the __example_only structural wrapper (which the loader strips) versus the literal substring (which is preserved verbatim).

environment: Organization: Acme Corp. Primary use: software development.
Source control: github.com/acme-corp and all repos under it.
Key internal services: Jenkins at ci.example.com, Artifactory at artifacts.example.com.
Documentation pointer: ./docs/$defaults-explainer.md (literal $defaults string is preserved here, not expanded)
allow: Pushing to feature branches under feature/* on github.com/acme-corp is allowed: feature branches are throwaway and reset on review.
Writing to s3://acme-scratch/ is allowed: ephemeral bucket with a 7-day lifecycle policy.
soft_deny: Never run database migrations outside the migrations CLI, even against dev databases.
Never modify files under infra/terraform/prod/: production infrastructure changes go through the review workflow.
hard_deny: Never force-push to main, develop, or release/* branches.
Never send repository contents to third-party code-review APIs.
